+# Decision: T06-A13 type-family forbid policy proof
+
+Date: 2026-10-17
+Status: Accepted
+Related milestone/version: mysql-tidb-ddl-completion (#79), task T06 / issue #85
+Related commits: T06-A13 proof commit on milestone/mysql-tidb-ddl-completion
+Related tests: `internal/infrastructure/parser/tidb/extractor_t06a13_test.go`, `internal/domain/rule/ddl/type_forbid_t06a13_test.go`, `internal/application/audit/batch_state_t06a13_test.go`, `pkg/deltascope/audit_type_forbid_t06a13_test.go`, `internal/interfaces/http/audit_type_forbid_t06a13_test.go`, `scripts/test_ddl_golden.py` T06-A13 contract group
+Related docs: `testdata/ddl-golden/T06.json`, `testdata/ddl-inventory/T06-base-traceability.md`, T06-A13 baseline `/tmp/ds-t06-a13-baseline/`
+
+## Context
+
+The T06-A13 baseline (offline, collected on evidence HEAD `84e37e32`)
+proved the five ordinary CREATE TABLE type-forbid rules already implement
+the frozen semantics on real parser output: a 32-run offline matrix
+(sixteen roles × mysql/tidb) plus a real-AST probe showed the per-column
+blocker attribution, the blob/text exclusion of JSON, the timestamp
+exclusion of DATETIME, the independent float/double finding shape, and the
+three distinct `rule_summary` states (loaded+applicable,
+loaded+inapplicable, absent). MySQL and TiDB finding output was
+byte-identical. No product red existed — what was missing was committed
+proof: the real-extraction → per-column attribution → isolated-profile
+finding identity chain had no dedicated evidence, and no anchored native
+observation bound the stored `DATA_TYPE` set to the policy verdict.
+
+## Decision
+
+- **Five independent team policies, one common mechanism.** BLOB/TEXT,
+  JSON, BIT, and TIMESTAMP forbid rules share the generic
+  `columnTypeForbiddenRule` (`params.forbid`, `baseType` matching,
+  `{table,column,type,family,charset}` metadata);
+  `ddl.column.float_double.forbid` is an independent implementation with
+  its own `switch` over `baseType` and a deliberately smaller
+  `{table,column,type}` metadata shape. Each is proven under its own
+  isolated profile — the same mixed SQL under five profiles is five
+  distinct roles bound by (sql, profile, rule_id, verdict), never
+  interchangeable records.
+- **Applicable-but-clean, forbid=false, and disabled are three different
+  states.** The safe input under an ON profile is `loaded=1,
+  applicable=1` with zero findings; `forbid=false` is `loaded=1,
+  applicable=0`; `all-rules-disabled` never loads the rule and
+  `rule_summary` is absent per the existing serialization contract.
+  None of the three is "the rule found nothing on the mixed input".
+- **Two findings keep per-column identity.** The blob/text and
+  float/double roles each emit exactly two findings; the contract matches
+  complete finding entries as a multiset (rule_id, level, message,
+  metadata map, statement index, location), so collapsing to one,
+  duplicating one entry over the other, or cross-pairing message and
+  metadata columns all fail.
+- **The exclusion boundaries are part of the predicate.** The registered
+  blob/text predicate is `isBlobTextLike(column) && !json` — the
+  `isBlobTextLike` set itself still contains `json` (that is the A12
+  exemption set, not the forbid set), so `c_json` is never absorbed by
+  `ddl.column.blob_text.forbid`. The timestamp predicate matches
+  `baseType=="timestamp"` only, so `c_datetime` is never absorbed by
+  `ddl.column.timestamp.forbid`.
+- **Declared parser fields and native `DATA_TYPE` are separate layers.**
+  The extractor records `Type` from `Tp.String()` lowercased — `BLOB`
+  renders `blob binary`, `BIT(1)` renders `bit(1)`, and the built-in
+  binary charset on BLOB/JSON leaves `spec.Charset` empty because no
+  charset was declared. The anchored oracle instead records the stored
+  `information_schema.COLUMNS.DATA_TYPE` (plus column name and ordinal):
+  `blob`, `text`, `json`, `bit`, `float`, `double`, `timestamp`,
+  `datetime`, `int`. Neither layer falsifies the other.
+- **A policy reject and a native rejection are separate facts.** Every
+  anchored `mixed-hit` case records the product `reject` verdict and the
+  driver-side CREATE success over the same SQL: the policy is a team
+  threshold, never a claim that the anchors reject the DDL. `TIMESTAMP
+  NULL` is a fixed input fact; no implicit-default, sql_mode, or
+  runtime-conversion claim follows from it.
+- **No schema changes.** `spec.Column` gains no fields; `rule_summary`
+  gains no field; the shipped defaults (warning level, `forbid` default
+  true) are unchanged — the isolated blocker levels live only in the
+  frozen profiles.
+
+## Public contract
+
+- Frozen case ids: `t06-a13-{mysql|tidb}-<family>-{mixed-hit|safe|forbid-false}` plus `t06-a13-{mysql|tidb}-mixed-off` (offline, 32) and `t06-a13-{mysql57|mysql80|mysql84|tidb85}-<family>-mixed-hit` (anchored, 20), raising T06 to 412 required cases.
+- Generic-rule message pinned verbatim: `column "<name>" must not use the <family> type family` with metadata `{table:t, column:<name>, type:<parser-rendered>, family:<blob/text|json|bit|timestamp>, charset:""}`; float/double messages `column "c_float" should not use float` / `column "c_double" should not use double` with metadata `{table:t, column, type}` only.
+- Isolated profiles: `t06-a13-<family>-on-isolated` (`enabled`, `level=blocker`, `params.forbid=true`) and `t06-a13-<family>-false-isolated` (`forbid=false`); `all-rules-disabled` is reused for the disabled control.
+- Anchored structure oracle: ordered `GROUP_CONCAT` of `schema:table:column:DATA_TYPE:ordinal` over the nine declared columns, plus independent table/column counts, zero PK constraints, zero primary index parts, no secondary indexes, and InnoDB on MySQL anchors.
+- The rules' shipped defaults are unchanged; nothing in this slice widens the PG `dialect=common` predicate scope or narrows it either.
+
+## Deferred / out of scope
+
+Explicitly out of this slice: BLOB/TEXT size variants
+(TINYBLOB/MEDIUMBLOB/LONGBLOB and TEXT equivalents beyond the two fixed
+columns), BIT length ranges and bit values, FLOAT precision args /
+rounding / REAL aliases / sql_mode, JSON document semantics / default
+expressions / JSON indexes, TIMESTAMP implicit defaults / ranges / time
+zones / `explicit_defaults_for_timestamp`, DECIMAL precision/scale,
+ALTER-side type governance, runtime values, and any auto-rewrite of
+rejected declarations.
+
+## Verification evidence
+
+- `go test -count=1 ./internal/infrastructure/parser/tidb ./internal/domain/rule/ddl ./internal/application/audit -run T06A13 -v` — real-extraction, rule-boundary, audit-role-matrix, and post-state groups green.
+- `go test -count=1` on `pkg/deltascope` and `internal/interfaces/http` — SDK/HTTP representatives green (float/double two-finding reject + safe pass; blob/text two-finding reject + safe pass as HTTP 200).
+- `make ddl-golden-validator-test` — contract cases green, including the T06-A13 mutation group (missed/forged findings, absorbed c_json/c_datetime, collapsed/duplicated/cross-paired findings, dropped or added metadata keys, same-SQL family swaps, switch-state laundering, weakened profiles, column-set corruptions, skipped or failed driver replay, denominator shrinkage).
+- `make ddl-golden TASK=T06` — 412/412 on the four frozen anchors; per-case driver replay, ordered nine-column sets, and structure oracles preserved in the artifact.

+// Package audit verifies the T06-A13 five ordinary CREATE TABLE type-family
+// forbid policies at the application seam.
+// input: the frozen mixed-type and safe inputs through AuditSQL under the
+// isolated on/false/off profiles, plus the M+ALTER input through the enrich
+// seam
+// output: per-role verdicts, complete per-column finding identity, the
+// loaded/applicable/absent rule_summary distinction, declaration-order
+// attribution, and follower pre-state Type/Charset propagation without
+// back-mutation
+// pos: application-layer contract tests for the frozen T06-A13 oracle
+// (issue #85)
+// note: if this file changes, update this header and module README.md.
+package audit
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	domainpolicy "github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/policy"
+	"github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/report"
+	"github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/rule"
+	ddlrules "github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/rule/ddl"
+	"github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/spec"
+)
+
+const t06A13MixedSQL = "CREATE TABLE t (c_blob BLOB, c_text TEXT, c_json JSON, c_bit BIT(1), c_float FLOAT, c_double DOUBLE, c_timestamp TIMESTAMP NULL, c_datetime DATETIME NULL, c_int INT);"
+const t06A13SafeSQL = "CREATE TABLE t (c_int INT, c_string VARCHAR(8), c_datetime DATETIME NULL);"
+
+// t06A13Families maps the five family keys to their rule IDs and the frozen
+// per-role attribution on M.
+func t06A13Families() []struct {
+	key     string
+	ruleID  string
+	columns []string
+	types   []string
+} {
+	return []struct {
+		key     string
+		ruleID  string
+		columns []string
+		types   []string
+	}{
+		{"blob-text", "ddl.column.blob_text.forbid",
+			[]string{"c_blob", "c_text"}, []string{"blob binary", "text"}},
+		{"json", "ddl.column.json.forbid",
+			[]string{"c_json"}, []string{"json"}},
+		{"bit", "ddl.column.bit.forbid",
+			[]string{"c_bit"}, []string{"bit(1)"}},
+		{"float-double", "ddl.column.float_double.forbid",
+			[]string{"c_float", "c_double"}, []string{"float", "double"}},
+		{"timestamp", "ddl.column.timestamp.forbid",
+			[]string{"c_timestamp"}, []string{"timestamp"}},
+	}
+}
+
+func t06A13Policy(t *testing.T, ruleID, params string) string {
+	t.Helper()
+	return t05PolicyPath(t, map[string]string{ruleID: params})
+}
+
+func t06A13Audit(t *testing.T, dialect spec.Dialect, sql, policy string) report.Result {
+	t.Helper()
+	result, err := AuditSQL(context.Background(), Request{
+		SQL: sql, Dialect: dialect, Schema: "golden",
+		ConfigPath: policy, MetadataProvider: &t05AbsentProvider{},
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("%s %q: unexpected error %v", dialect, sql, err)
+	}
+	if len(result.Statements) == 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("%s %q: no statements projected", dialect, sql)
+	}
+	return result
+}
+
+// TestT06A13OfflineRoleMatrix runs the 32-role frozen matrix through
+// AuditSQL under both dialects: M×ON pins the per-column attribution and
+// complete finding identity; S×ON pins loaded+applicable with zero hits;
+// M×FALSE pins loaded-but-inapplicable; M×OFF pins the absent summary.
+func TestT06A13OfflineRoleMatrix(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	for _, dialect := range []spec.Dialect{spec.DialectMySQL, spec.DialectTiDB} {
+		for _, family := range t06A13Families() {
+			family := family
+			on := t06A13Policy(t, family.ruleID, "      forbid: true\n")
+			offFalse := t06A13Policy(t, family.ruleID, "      forbid: false\n")
+
+			t.Run(string(dialect)+"/"+family.key+"-mixed-hit", func(t *testing.T) {
+				result := t06A13Audit(t, dialect, t06A13MixedSQL, on)
+				statement := result.Statements[0]
+				if statement.Index != 0 || statement.Kind != "ddl" || statement.RawSQL != t06A13MixedSQL {
+					t.Fatalf("statement identity = %+v", statement)
+				}
+				if result.Verdict != report.VerdictReject || result.Summary.Blockers != len(family.columns) ||
+					result.Summary.Warnings != 0 || result.Summary.Notices != 0 {
+					t.Fatalf("verdict/summary = %s/%+v, want reject with %d blockers",
+						result.Verdict, result.Summary, len(family.columns))
+				}
+				if result.RuleSummary == nil || result.RuleSummary.Loaded != 1 || result.RuleSummary.Applicable != 1 {
+					t.Fatalf("rule summary = %+v, want loaded=1 applicable=1", result.RuleSummary)
+				}
+				if len(statement.Findings) != len(family.columns) {
+					t.Fatalf("findings = %+v, want %d on %v", statement.Findings, len(family.columns), family.columns)
+				}
+				for i, column := range family.columns {
+					finding := statement.Findings[i]
+					if finding.RuleID != family.ruleID || finding.Level != "blocker" {
+						t.Fatalf("finding[%d] = %+v, want %s blocker", i, finding, family.ruleID)
+					}
+					var wantMessage string
+					if family.key == "float-double" {
+						wantMessage = `column "` + column + `" should not use ` + family.types[i]
+					} else {
+						familyName := map[string]string{"blob-text": "blob/text", "json": "json", "bit": "bit", "timestamp": "timestamp"}[family.key]
+						wantMessage = `column "` + column + `" must not use the ` + familyName + ` type family`
+					}
+					if finding.Message != wantMessage {
+						t.Fatalf("finding[%d] message = %q, want %q", i, finding.Message, wantMessage)
+					}
+					if finding.Metadata["table"] != "t" || finding.Metadata["column"] != column ||
+						finding.Metadata["type"] != family.types[i] {
+						t.Fatalf("finding[%d] metadata = %+v, want %s %s", i, finding.Metadata, column, family.types[i])
+					}
+					if family.key == "float-double" {
+						if _, ok := finding.Metadata["family"]; ok {
+							t.Fatalf("float finding[%d] metadata = %+v carries family", i, finding.Metadata)
+						}
+					} else {
+						if _, ok := finding.Metadata["charset"]; !ok {
+							t.Fatalf("finding[%d] metadata = %+v lacks charset", i, finding.Metadata)
+						}
+					}
+				}
+			})
+
+			t.Run(string(dialect)+"/"+family.key+"-safe", func(t *testing.T) {
+				result := t06A13Audit(t, dialect, t06A13SafeSQL, on)
+				if result.Verdict != report.VerdictPass || len(result.Statements[0].Findings) != 0 {
+					t.Fatalf("verdict/findings = %s/%+v, want pass with none",
+						result.Verdict, result.Statements[0].Findings)
+				}
+				if result.RuleSummary == nil || result.RuleSummary.Loaded != 1 || result.RuleSummary.Applicable != 1 {
+					t.Fatalf("rule summary = %+v, want loaded=1 applicable=1 — applicable, no hits", result.RuleSummary)
+				}
+			})
+
+			t.Run(string(dialect)+"/"+family.key+"-forbid-false", func(t *testing.T) {
+				result := t06A13Audit(t, dialect, t06A13MixedSQL, offFalse)
+				if result.Verdict != report.VerdictPass || len(result.Statements[0].Findings) != 0 {
+					t.Fatalf("verdict/findings = %s/%+v, want pass with none",
+						result.Verdict, result.Statements[0].Findings)
+				}
+				if result.RuleSummary == nil || result.RuleSummary.Loaded != 1 || result.RuleSummary.Applicable != 0 {
+					t.Fatalf("rule summary = %+v, want loaded=1 applicable=0 — forbid=false", result.RuleSummary)
+				}
+			})
+		}
+
+		t.Run(string(dialect)+"/mixed-off", func(t *testing.T) {
+			result := t06A13Audit(t, dialect, t06A13MixedSQL, t05PolicyPath(t, map[string]string{}))
+			if result.Verdict != report.VerdictPass || len(result.Statements[0].Findings) != 0 {
+				t.Fatalf("verdict/findings = %s/%+v, want pass with none",
+					result.Verdict, result.Statements[0].Findings)
+			}
+			if result.RuleSummary != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("rule summary = %+v, want absent for all-off", result.RuleSummary)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+// TestT06A13ReorderedAttribution pins the bounded reorder control through
+// AuditSQL: moving matching columns behind non-matching ones keeps the
+// findings bound to the real declared columns in declaration order.
+func TestT06A13ReorderedAttribution(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	reordered := "CREATE TABLE t (c_int INT, c_text TEXT, c_double DOUBLE, c_blob BLOB, c_float FLOAT);"
+	for _, dialect := range []spec.Dialect{spec.DialectMySQL, spec.DialectTiDB} {
+		t.Run(string(dialect)+"/blob-text", func(t *testing.T) {
+			result := t06A13Audit(t, dialect, reordered,
+				t06A13Policy(t, "ddl.column.blob_text.forbid", "      forbid: true\n"))
+			findings := result.Statements[0].Findings
+			if len(findings) != 2 || findings[0].Metadata["column"] != "c_text" ||
+				findings[1].Metadata["column"] != "c_blob" {
+				t.Fatalf("findings = %+v, want [c_text, c_blob]", findings)
+			}
+		})
+		t.Run(string(dialect)+"/float-double", func(t *testing.T) {
+			result := t06A13Audit(t, dialect, reordered,
+				t06A13Policy(t, "ddl.column.float_double.forbid", "      forbid: true\n"))
+			findings := result.Statements[0].Findings
+			if len(findings) != 2 || findings[0].Metadata["column"] != "c_double" ||
+				findings[1].Metadata["column"] != "c_float" {
+				t.Fatalf("findings = %+v, want [c_double, c_float]", findings)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+// TestT06A13DerivedPreStateCarriesTypes pins the enrich seam on M+ALTER:
+// the follower reads a derived snapshot carrying all nine declared columns
+// in order with Type/Charset/Length intact, the provider was consulted
+// exactly once for golden.t, and neither the policy verdict nor the
+// publication rewrites the source declaration.
+func TestT06A13DerivedPreStateCarriesTypes(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	wants := []struct {
+		name    string
+		typ     string
+		charset string
+		length  int
+	}{
+		{"c_blob", "blob binary", "", -1}, {"c_text", "text", "", -1},
+		{"c_json", "json", "", -1}, {"c_bit", "bit(1)", "", 1},
+		{"c_float", "float", "", -1}, {"c_double", "double", "", -1},
+		{"c_timestamp", "timestamp", "", 19}, {"c_datetime", "datetime", "", 19},
+		{"c_int", "int(11)", "", -1},
+	}
+	for _, dialect := range []spec.Dialect{spec.DialectMySQL, spec.DialectTiDB} {
+		t.Run(string(dialect), func(t *testing.T) {
+			ctx := context.Background()
+			sql := t06A13MixedSQL + "\nALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN next_c INT;"
+			parsed, err := Parse(ctx, sql, dialect)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			statements, err := Extract(ctx, parsed)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if len(statements) != 2 {
+				t.Fatalf("extracted = %d, want 2", len(statements))
+			}
+			provider := &t05AbsentProvider{}
+			state := newBatchState(dialect, "golden", provider)
+			facts, _ := provider.LoadInstanceFacts(ctx, dialect, "golden")
+			enriched, err := state.enrichStatements(ctx, &MetadataRequest{Schema: "golden", Provider: provider},
+				statements, parsed.failures, facts, auditLimits{orderedStatements: 2})
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			var snapshot *spec.TableSnapshot
+			if enriched[1].Metadata != nil {
+				snapshot = enriched[1].Metadata.TargetTable
+			}
+			if snapshot == nil || !snapshot.Exists {
+				t.Fatalf("follower pre-state = %+v, want an existing t", snapshot)
+			}
+			if len(snapshot.Columns) != len(wants) {
+				t.Fatalf("pre-state columns = %#v, want %d", snapshot.Columns, len(wants))
+			}
+			for i, want := range wants {
+				column := snapshot.Columns[i]
+				if column.Name != want.name || column.Type != want.typ ||
+					column.Charset != want.charset || column.Length != want.length {
+					t.Fatalf("pre-state column[%d] = %#v, want %s %s charset=%q len=%d",
+						i, column, want.name, want.typ, want.charset, want.length)
+				}
+				if &snapshot.Columns[i] == &statements[0].DDL.Columns[i] {
+					t.Fatalf("pre-state column[%d] shares statement storage — must be a clone", i)
+				}
+			}
+			if snapshot.PrimaryKey != nil || len(snapshot.Indexes) != 0 {
+				t.Fatalf("pre-state pk/indexes = %#v/%#v, want none", snapshot.PrimaryKey, snapshot.Indexes)
+			}
+			reads := 0
+			for _, call := range provider.calls {
+				if call == "golden.t" {
+					reads++
+				}
+			}
+			if reads != 1 {
+				t.Fatalf("provider reads for golden.t = %d, want exactly 1", reads)
+			}
+			// The source declaration is never back-mutated.
+			for i, want := range wants {
+				if statements[0].DDL.Columns[i].Type != want.typ {
+					t.Fatalf("source column[%d] Type mutated to %q, want %q",
+						i, statements[0].DDL.Columns[i].Type, want.typ)
+				}
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+// TestT06A13PolicyVerdictDoesNotMutateSource pins the audit/immutability
+// boundary on the real evaluation seam: the blob-text policy rejects the
+// mixed declaration, yet the extracted columns keep their declared types —
+// a verdict is never a rewrite.
+func TestT06A13PolicyVerdictDoesNotMutateSource(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	for _, dialect := range []spec.Dialect{spec.DialectMySQL, spec.DialectTiDB} {
+		t.Run(string(dialect), func(t *testing.T) {
+			ctx := context.Background()
+			parsed, err := Parse(ctx, t06A13MixedSQL, dialect)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			statements, err := Extract(ctx, parsed)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			registry := rule.NewRegistry()
+			if err := ddlrules.Register(registry, domainpolicy.Policy{Rules: map[string]domainpolicy.RulePolicy{
+				"ddl.column.blob_text.forbid": {Enabled: true, Level: rule.LevelBlocker,
+					Params: map[string]any{"forbid": true}},
+			}}); err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("register: %v", err)
+			}
+			result, err := EvaluateStatements(ctx, registry, statements)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("evaluate: %v", err)
+			}
+			if result.Verdict != report.VerdictReject || len(result.Statements[0].Findings) != 2 {
+				t.Fatalf("verdict/findings = %s/%+v, want reject with c_blob+c_text",
+					result.Verdict, result.Statements[0].Findings)
+			}
+			wantTypes := []string{"blob binary", "text", "json", "bit(1)", "float",
+				"double", "timestamp", "datetime", "int(11)"}
+			for i, column := range statements[0].DDL.Columns {
+				if column.Type != wantTypes[i] {
+					t.Fatalf("column %s Type mutated to %q by policy reject", column.Name, column.Type)
+				}
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+// Package ddl verifies the T06-A13 five ordinary CREATE TABLE type-family
+// forbid policies on synthetic statements.
+// input: the frozen mixed-type and safe column sets through each rule's
+// registered constructor and through the real registry seam
+// output: per-rule per-column attribution including the JSON and DATETIME
+// exclusions, the FLOAT/DOUBLE split finding shapes, forbid=true/false,
+// enabled=false, default level/params, invalid-parameter controls, the
+// declaration-order control, and the CREATE-only applicability seam
+// pos: domain DDL rule regression for issue #85 T06-A13
+// note: if this file changes, update this header and module README.md.
+package ddl
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/policy"
+	"github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/rule"
+	"github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/spec"
+)

+// t06A13Columns mirrors the frozen mixed input M as extracted spec facts —
+// the rendered types observed through the real extractor at baseline.
+func t06A13Columns() []spec.Column {
+	return []spec.Column{
+		{Name: "c_blob", Type: "blob binary"},
+		{Name: "c_text", Type: "text"},
+		{Name: "c_json", Type: "json"},
+		{Name: "c_bit", Type: "bit(1)"},
+		{Name: "c_float", Type: "float"},
+		{Name: "c_double", Type: "double"},
+		{Name: "c_timestamp", Type: "timestamp"},
+		{Name: "c_datetime", Type: "datetime"},
+		{Name: "c_int", Type: "int(11)"},
+	}
+}
+
+func t06A13BlockerParams() map[string]any {
+	return map[string]any{"forbid": true}
+}

+// TestT06A13RegisteredAttribution runs the frozen mixed table through the
+// real registration seam with each rule enabled alone at blocker — pinning
+// that the registered predicate (not a duplicated lambda) produces exactly
+// the frozen per-column attribution.
+func TestT06A13RegisteredAttribution(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	statement := createTableWithColumns("t", t06A13Columns()...)
+	roles := []struct {
+		name        string
+		ruleID      string
+		wantColumns []string
+	}{
+		{"blob-text", ruleIDColumnBlobTextForbid, []string{"c_blob", "c_text"}},
+		{"json", ruleIDColumnJSONForbid, []string{"c_json"}},
+		{"bit", ruleIDColumnBitForbid, []string{"c_bit"}},
+		{"float-double", ruleIDColumnFloatDoubleForbid, []string{"c_float", "c_double"}},
+		{"timestamp", ruleIDColumnTimestampForbid, []string{"c_timestamp"}},
+	}
+	for _, role := range roles {
+		role := role
+		t.Run(role.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Parallel()
+			registry := rule.NewRegistry()
+			if err := Register(registry, policy.Policy{Rules: map[string]policy.RulePolicy{
+				role.ruleID: {Enabled: true, Level: rule.LevelBlocker, Params: t06A13BlockerParams()},
+			}}); err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("register: %v", err)
+			}
+			findings, err := registry.EvaluateStatement(ctx, statement)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("evaluate: %v", err)
+			}
+			if len(findings) != len(role.wantColumns) {
+				t.Fatalf("findings = %+v, want %d on %v", findings, len(role.wantColumns), role.wantColumns)
+			}
+			for i, want := range role.wantColumns {
+				finding := findings[i]
+				if finding.RuleID != role.ruleID || finding.Level != rule.LevelBlocker ||
+					finding.Metadata["column"] != want || finding.Metadata["table"] != "t" {
+					t.Fatalf("finding[%d] = %+v, want %s blocker on %s", i, finding, role.ruleID, want)
+				}
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+// TestT06A13FindingShapes pins the two finding shapes: the shared
+// columnTypeForbiddenRule emits "must not use the <family> type family"
+// with table/column/type/family/charset (charset present even when empty),
+// while the independent float/double rule emits "should not use <type>"
+// with only table/column/type — the shapes are never unified.
+func TestT06A13FindingShapes(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	statement := createTableWithColumns("t", t06A13Columns()...)
+	run := func(t *testing.T, ruleID string) []rule.Finding {
+		t.Helper()
+		registry := rule.NewRegistry()
+		if err := Register(registry, policy.Policy{Rules: map[string]policy.RulePolicy{
+			ruleID: {Enabled: true, Level: rule.LevelBlocker, Params: t06A13BlockerParams()},
+		}}); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("register: %v", err)
+		}
+		findings, err := registry.EvaluateStatement(ctx, statement)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("evaluate: %v", err)
+		}
+		return findings
+	}
+
+	families := map[string]string{
+		ruleIDColumnBlobTextForbid:  "blob/text",
+		ruleIDColumnJSONForbid:      "json",
+		ruleIDColumnBitForbid:       "bit",
+		ruleIDColumnTimestampForbid: "timestamp",
+	}
+	for ruleID, family := range families {
+		for _, finding := range run(t, ruleID) {
+			column := finding.Metadata["column"]
+			want := `column "` + column.(string) + `" must not use the ` + family + ` type family`
+			if finding.Message != want {
+				t.Fatalf("%s message = %q, want %q", ruleID, finding.Message, want)
+			}
+			if finding.Metadata["family"] != family {
+				t.Fatalf("%s family = %v, want %s", ruleID, finding.Metadata["family"], family)
+			}
+			if _, ok := finding.Metadata["charset"]; !ok {
+				t.Fatalf("%s metadata %v lacks the charset key (empty string is a real value)",
+					ruleID, finding.Metadata)
+			}
+			if finding.Metadata["type"] == nil || finding.Metadata["table"] != "t" {
+				t.Fatalf("%s metadata = %+v, want type/table bound", ruleID, finding.Metadata)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	floats := run(t, ruleIDColumnFloatDoubleForbid)
+	wants := []struct{ column, typ string }{{"c_float", "float"}, {"c_double", "double"}}
+	for i, want := range wants {
+		finding := floats[i]
+		if finding.Message != `column "`+want.column+`" should not use `+want.typ ||
+			finding.Metadata["type"] != want.typ {
+			t.Fatalf("float finding[%d] = %+v, want %s %s", i, finding, want.column, want.typ)
+		}
+		if _, ok := finding.Metadata["family"]; ok {
+			t.Fatalf("float finding[%d] metadata = %+v carries a family key — wrong shape", i, finding.Metadata)
+		}
+		if _, ok := finding.Metadata["charset"]; ok {
+			t.Fatalf("float finding[%d] metadata = %+v carries a charset key — wrong shape", i, finding.Metadata)
+		}
+		if len(finding.Metadata) != 3 {
+			t.Fatalf("float finding[%d] metadata = %+v, want exactly table/column/type", i, finding.Metadata)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// TestT06A13ForbidDisabledAndDefaults pins the three loaded states per rule:
+// forbid=true reports, forbid=false keeps the rule loaded but inapplicable,
+// enabled=false never registers — and an omitted forbid or level falls back
+// to the product defaults (forbid=true, warning), never the isolated
+// profiles' blocker.
+func TestT06A13ForbidDisabledAndDefaults(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	statement := createTableWithColumns("t", t06A13Columns()...)
+	ruleIDs := []string{
+		ruleIDColumnBlobTextForbid, ruleIDColumnJSONForbid, ruleIDColumnBitForbid,
+		ruleIDColumnFloatDoubleForbid, ruleIDColumnTimestampForbid,
+	}
+	for _, ruleID := range ruleIDs {
+		ruleID := ruleID
+		t.Run(ruleID+"/forbid-false", func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Parallel()
+			registry := rule.NewRegistry()
+			if err := Register(registry, policy.Policy{Rules: map[string]policy.RulePolicy{
+				ruleID: {Enabled: true, Level: rule.LevelBlocker, Params: map[string]any{"forbid": false}},
+			}}); err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("register: %v", err)
+			}
+			findings, err := registry.EvaluateStatement(ctx, statement)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("evaluate: %v", err)
+			}
+			if len(findings) != 0 {
+				t.Fatalf("forbid=false findings = %+v, want none — loaded but inapplicable", findings)
+			}
+			if !registry.Contains(ruleID) {
+				t.Fatalf("forbid=false rule %s must still be loaded", ruleID)
+			}
+		})
+		t.Run(ruleID+"/disabled", func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Parallel()
+			registry := rule.NewRegistry()
+			if err := Register(registry, policy.Policy{Rules: map[string]policy.RulePolicy{
+				ruleID: {Enabled: false},
+			}}); err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("register: %v", err)
+			}
+			if registry.Contains(ruleID) {
+				t.Fatalf("disabled rule %s must not be loaded", ruleID)
+			}
+			findings, err := registry.EvaluateStatement(ctx, statement)
+			if err != nil || len(findings) != 0 {
+				t.Fatalf("disabled findings = %+v err = %v, want none", findings, err)
+			}
+		})
+		t.Run(ruleID+"/defaults", func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Parallel()
+			registry := rule.NewRegistry()
+			if err := Register(registry, policy.Policy{Rules: map[string]policy.RulePolicy{
+				ruleID: {Enabled: true},
+			}}); err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("register: %v", err)
+			}
+			findings, err := registry.EvaluateStatement(ctx, statement)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("evaluate: %v", err)
+			}
+			// Default forbid=true fires at the default warning level.
+			wantCounts := map[string]int{
+				ruleIDColumnBlobTextForbid: 2, ruleIDColumnJSONForbid: 1,
+				ruleIDColumnBitForbid: 1, ruleIDColumnFloatDoubleForbid: 2,
+				ruleIDColumnTimestampForbid: 1,
+			}
+			if len(findings) != wantCounts[ruleID] {
+				t.Fatalf("default findings = %+v, want %d", findings, wantCounts[ruleID])
+			}
+			for _, finding := range findings {
+				if finding.Level != rule.LevelWarning {
+					t.Fatalf("default finding level = %s, want warning — never the isolated blocker", finding.Level)
+				}
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+// TestT06A13InvalidForbidParameter pins boolParam's strict typing on the
+// forbid parameter for all five rules: a non-bool value fails construction,
+// never coerces.
+func TestT06A13InvalidForbidParameter(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	for _, ruleID := range []string{
+		ruleIDColumnBlobTextForbid, ruleIDColumnJSONForbid, ruleIDColumnBitForbid,
+		ruleIDColumnFloatDoubleForbid, ruleIDColumnTimestampForbid,
+	} {
+		ruleID := ruleID
+		for _, bad := range []any{"yes", 1, 0.0} {
+			t.Run(ruleID, func(t *testing.T) {
+				registry := rule.NewRegistry()
+				err := Register(registry, policy.Policy{Rules: map[string]policy.RulePolicy{
+					ruleID: {Enabled: true, Params: map[string]any{"forbid": bad}},
+				}})
+				if err == nil {
+					t.Fatalf("forbid=%v (%T) must fail rule construction", bad, bad)
+				}
+			})
+		}
+	}
+}

+// TestT06A13ExclusionBoundaries pins the two carved-out boundaries the
+// forbid sets must not swallow: the BLOB/TEXT family excludes JSON (the
+// A12 isBlobTextLike exemption set contains json — this rule's registered
+// predicate subtracts it back out), and TIMESTAMP excludes DATETIME.
+func TestT06A13ExclusionBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	registry := rule.NewRegistry()
+	if err := Register(registry, policy.Policy{Rules: map[string]policy.RulePolicy{
+		ruleIDColumnBlobTextForbid:  {Enabled: true, Level: rule.LevelBlocker, Params: t06A13BlockerParams()},
+		ruleIDColumnTimestampForbid: {Enabled: true, Level: rule.LevelBlocker, Params: t06A13BlockerParams()},
+	}}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("register: %v", err)
+	}
+	statement := createTableWithColumns("t",
+		spec.Column{Name: "only_json", Type: "json"},
+		spec.Column{Name: "only_datetime", Type: "datetime"})
+	findings, err := registry.EvaluateStatement(ctx, statement)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("evaluate: %v", err)
+	}
+	if len(findings) != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("json-only + datetime-only findings = %+v, want none", findings)
+	}
+}

+// TestT06A13ReorderedColumns pins that finding order follows declaration
+// order and attribution follows the declared column — moving matching
+// columns behind non-matching ones never changes which column owns a
+// finding.
+func TestT06A13ReorderedColumns(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	roles := []struct {
+		ruleID      string
+		wantColumns []string
+	}{
+		{ruleIDColumnBlobTextForbid, []string{"mid_text", "tail_blob"}},
+		{ruleIDColumnFloatDoubleForbid, []string{"mid_double", "tail_float"}},
+	}
+	for _, role := range roles {
+		role := role
+		t.Run(role.ruleID, func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Parallel()
+			registry := rule.NewRegistry()
+			if err := Register(registry, policy.Policy{Rules: map[string]policy.RulePolicy{
+				role.ruleID: {Enabled: true, Level: rule.LevelBlocker, Params: t06A13BlockerParams()},
+			}}); err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("register: %v", err)
+			}
+			statement := createTableWithColumns("t",
+				spec.Column{Name: "lead_int", Type: "int(11)"},
+				spec.Column{Name: "mid_text", Type: "text"},
+				spec.Column{Name: "mid_double", Type: "double"},
+				spec.Column{Name: "tail_blob", Type: "blob binary"},
+				spec.Column{Name: "tail_float", Type: "float"})
+			findings, err := registry.EvaluateStatement(ctx, statement)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("evaluate: %v", err)
+			}
+			if len(findings) != len(role.wantColumns) {
+				t.Fatalf("findings = %+v, want %d", findings, len(role.wantColumns))
+			}
+			for i, want := range role.wantColumns {
+				if findings[i].Metadata["column"] != want {
+					t.Fatalf("finding[%d] column = %v, want %s", i, findings[i].Metadata["column"], want)
+				}
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+// TestT06A13CreateTableOnlySeam pins the rules' applicability to CREATE
+// TABLE columns: an ALTER statement carrying the same types does not fall
+// under these rules — ALTER-side type governance stays out of scope.
+func TestT06A13CreateTableOnlySeam(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	alter := spec.Statement{
+		Kind: spec.KindDDL,
+		DDL: &spec.DDL{
+			Operation: spec.DDLOperationAlterTable,
+			Table:     &spec.Table{Name: "t"},
+			Alter: []spec.Alter{{Action: "modify_column", Name: "c",
+				Column: &spec.AlterColumn{Definition: &spec.Column{Name: "c", Type: "text"}}}},
+		},
+	}
+	for _, ruleID := range []string{
+		ruleIDColumnBlobTextForbid, ruleIDColumnJSONForbid, ruleIDColumnBitForbid,
+		ruleIDColumnFloatDoubleForbid, ruleIDColumnTimestampForbid,
+	} {
+		registry := rule.NewRegistry()
+		if err := Register(registry, policy.Policy{Rules: map[string]policy.RulePolicy{
+			ruleID: {Enabled: true, Level: rule.LevelBlocker, Params: t06A13BlockerParams()},
+		}}); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("register %s: %v", ruleID, err)
+		}
+		findings, err := registry.EvaluateStatement(ctx, alter)
+		if err != nil || len(findings) != 0 {
+			t.Fatalf("%s alter findings = %+v err = %v, want none", ruleID, findings, err)
+		}
+	}
+}

+// Package tidb verifies the T06-A13 extracted facts the five type-family
+// forbid policies consume.
+// input: the frozen mixed-type and safe CREATE TABLE inputs through the real
+// parse+extract seam under both dialects
+// output: per-column AST rendering and spec Column facts pinned in
+// declaration order — including the blob BINARY render, the AST-binary vs
+// spec-Charset="" distinction, and the absence of undeclared default/update
+// semantics
+// pos: extractor contract tests for the frozen T06-A13 oracle (issue #85)
+// note: if this file changes, update this header and module README.md.
+package tidbparser
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/spec"
+)
+
+const t06A13MixedSQL = "CREATE TABLE t (c_blob BLOB, c_text TEXT, c_json JSON, c_bit BIT(1), c_float FLOAT, c_double DOUBLE, c_timestamp TIMESTAMP NULL, c_datetime DATETIME NULL, c_int INT);"
+const t06A13SafeSQL = "CREATE TABLE t (c_int INT, c_string VARCHAR(8), c_datetime DATETIME NULL);"
+
+// t06A13Column pins the extracted-fact want for one declared column. Type is
+// the parser-rendered text verbatim (BLOB renders `blob binary`, BIT keeps
+// its declared width `bit(1)`, a bare timestamp/datetime carries flen 19 as
+// the parser's display width — none of these is a user-declared fsp or a
+// server COLUMN_TYPE oracle). charset/collation are the spec fields, which
+// stay empty when the AST-level binary charset does not surface.
+type t06A13Column struct {
+	name      string
+	typeText  string
+	length    int
+	charset   string
+	collation string
+	notNull   bool
+}
+
+var t06A13Inputs = []struct {
+	name    string
+	sql     string
+	columns []t06A13Column
+}{
+	{name: "mixed", sql: t06A13MixedSQL, columns: []t06A13Column{
+		{name: "c_blob", typeText: "blob binary", length: -1},
+		{name: "c_text", typeText: "text", length: -1},
+		{name: "c_json", typeText: "json", length: -1},
+		{name: "c_bit", typeText: "bit(1)", length: 1},
+		{name: "c_float", typeText: "float", length: -1},
+		{name: "c_double", typeText: "double", length: -1},
+		{name: "c_timestamp", typeText: "timestamp", length: 19},
+		{name: "c_datetime", typeText: "datetime", length: 19},
+		{name: "c_int", typeText: "int(11)", length: -1},
+	}},
+	{name: "safe", sql: t06A13SafeSQL, columns: []t06A13Column{
+		{name: "c_int", typeText: "int(11)", length: -1},
+		{name: "c_string", typeText: "varchar(8)", length: 8},
+		{name: "c_datetime", typeText: "datetime", length: 19},
+	}},
+}
+
+// TestExtractorT06A13ColumnFacts pins the extracted per-column facts the
+// five forbid policies match on: declaration order, name, rendered Type,
+// Length, Charset/Collation, NotNull — plus the absence of primary key,
+// indexes, and any default/on-update semantics the input never declared.
+func TestExtractorT06A13ColumnFacts(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	for _, dialect := range []spec.Dialect{spec.DialectMySQL, spec.DialectTiDB} {
+		for _, tc := range t06A13Inputs {
+			tc := tc
+			t.Run(string(dialect)+"/"+tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+				t.Parallel()
+				_, statement := parseExtractT06A12(t, dialect, tc.sql)
+				if statement.Kind != spec.KindDDL || statement.DDL == nil {
+					t.Fatalf("statement kind = %v, want ddl", statement.Kind)
+				}
+				if len(statement.DDL.Columns) != len(tc.columns) {
+					t.Fatalf("columns = %#v, want %d", statement.DDL.Columns, len(tc.columns))
+				}
+				for i, want := range tc.columns {
+					column := statement.DDL.Columns[i]
+					if column.Name != want.name || column.Type != want.typeText ||
+						column.Length != want.length || column.NotNull != want.notNull ||
+						column.Charset != want.charset || column.Collation != want.collation {
+						t.Fatalf("column[%d] = %#v, want %s %s len=%d charset=%q collation=%q notNull=%v",
+							i, column, want.name, want.typeText, want.length,
+							want.charset, want.collation, want.notNull)
+					}
+					if column.HasDefault || column.DefaultIsCurrentTimestamp ||
+						column.OnUpdateCurrentTimestamp {
+						t.Fatalf("column[%d] = %#v carries undeclared default/update semantics", i, column)
+					}
+				}
+				if statement.DDL.PrimaryKey != nil || len(statement.DDL.Indexes) != 0 ||
+					len(statement.DDL.Constraints) != 0 {
+					t.Fatalf("pk/indexes/constraints = %#v/%#v/%#v, want none",
+						statement.DDL.PrimaryKey, statement.DDL.Indexes, statement.DDL.Constraints)
+				}
+			})
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// TestExtractorT06A13BinaryCharsetBoundary pins the representational
+// boundary the forbid findings inherit: the AST carries a built-in binary
+// charset for BLOB and JSON, but tidbtypes.HasCharset does not surface it,
+// so the spec's explicit Charset stays "" — while the type text itself
+// keeps the parser's `blob binary`/`json` rendering. TEXT, by contrast, is
+// charset-capable and still reports "" because no charset was declared.
+func TestExtractorT06A13BinaryCharsetBoundary(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	for _, dialect := range []spec.Dialect{spec.DialectMySQL, spec.DialectTiDB} {
+		t.Run(string(dialect), func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Parallel()
+			create, statement := parseExtractT06A12(t, dialect, t06A13MixedSQL)
+			astByName := map[string]int{}
+			for i, col := range create.Cols {
+				astByName[col.Name.Name.L] = i
+			}
+			cases := []struct {
+				column      string
+				wantASTCS   string // FieldType-reported charset, observed only
+				wantSpecCS  string
+				wantTypeStr string
+			}{
+				{"c_blob", "binary", "", "blob binary"},
+				{"c_json", "binary", "", "json"},
+				{"c_text", "", "", "text"},
+				{"c_bit", "", "", "bit(1)"},
+			}
+			for _, tc := range cases {
+				i, ok := astByName[tc.column]
+				if !ok {
+					t.Fatalf("column %s missing from ast", tc.column)
+				}
+				if got := create.Cols[i].Tp.GetCharset(); got != tc.wantASTCS {
+					t.Fatalf("%s ast charset = %q, want %q", tc.column, got, tc.wantASTCS)
+				}
+				specCol := statement.DDL.Columns[i]
+				if specCol.Name != tc.column || specCol.Charset != tc.wantSpecCS {
+					t.Fatalf("spec column[%d] = %#v, want name=%s charset=%q",
+						i, specCol, tc.column, tc.wantSpecCS)
+				}
+				if specCol.Type != tc.wantTypeStr {
+					t.Fatalf("spec column[%d] type = %q, want %q", i, specCol.Type, tc.wantTypeStr)
+				}
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+// Package httpapi verifies the T06-A13 BLOB/TEXT forbid policy at the HTTP
+// seam.
+// input: POST /v1/audit bodies carrying the frozen mixed-type and safe
+// inputs under the isolated blob-text policy
+// output: HTTP 200 with a two-blocker reject payload bound to the declared
+// columns and a pass payload — policy rejects stay ordinary audit results,
+// never transport errors
+// pos: HTTP transport contract test for issue #85 T06-A13
+// note: if this file changes, update this header and module README.md.
+package httpapi
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+// TestHandlerT06A13BlobTextReject posts the mixed declaration under the
+// isolated blob-text blocker policy — the reject stays a populated 200
+// audit result carrying exactly the two column-bound findings (c_json is
+// not swept in).
+func TestHandlerT06A13BlobTextReject(t *testing.T) {
+	policy := t06A8HTTPPolicy(t, map[string]string{
+		"ddl.column.blob_text.forbid": "      forbid: true\n",
+	})
+	code, payload := postT06A8Audit(t, policy,
+		"CREATE TABLE t (c_blob BLOB, c_text TEXT, c_json JSON, c_bit BIT(1), c_float FLOAT, c_double DOUBLE, c_timestamp TIMESTAMP NULL, c_datetime DATETIME NULL, c_int INT);")
+	if code != http.StatusOK {
+		t.Fatalf("status = %d, want 200: %#v", code, payload)
+	}
+	if payload["verdict"] != "reject" {
+		t.Fatalf("verdict = %#v, want reject", payload["verdict"])
+	}
+	statements, _ := payload["statements"].([]any)
+	if len(statements) != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("statements = %#v, want 1", statements)
+	}
+	findings, _ := statements[0].(map[string]any)["findings"].([]any)
+	if len(findings) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("findings = %#v, want exactly two", findings)
+	}
+	for i, want := range []string{"c_blob", "c_text"} {
+		finding, _ := findings[i].(map[string]any)
+		metadata, _ := finding["metadata"].(map[string]any)
+		if finding["rule_id"] != "ddl.column.blob_text.forbid" ||
+			finding["level"] != "blocker" ||
+			finding["message"] != `column "`+want+`" must not use the blob/text type family` ||
+			metadata["column"] != want {
+			t.Fatalf("finding[%d] = %#v, want the blob/text blocker bound to %s", i, finding, want)
+		}
+	}
+}

+    attribution on M — rule/message/full metadata map, never a count."""

+def t06_a13_role_shape(local_id):
+    """Decode an A13 local case id into (family, role). Returns
+    (None, "mixed-off") for the all-off control; (family, role) where role is
+    mixed-hit/safe/forbid-false otherwise."""
+    tail = local_id[len("t06-a13-"):]
+    for token in ("mysql57", "mysql80", "mysql84", "tidb85", "mysql", "tidb"):
+        if tail.startswith(token + "-"):
+            tail = tail[len(token) + 1:]
+            break
+    if tail == "mixed-off":
+        return None, "mixed-off"
+    for suffix, role in (("-forbid-false", "forbid-false"),
+                         ("-mixed-hit", "mixed-hit"), ("-safe", "safe")):
+        if tail.endswith(suffix):
+            return tail[:-len(suffix)], role
+    return None, None
+
+
+def t06_a13_artifact_failures(artifact, manifest):
+    """T06-A13 (issue #85): pin the per-role rule_summary contract and the
+    family binding, re-parsed from recorded raw stdout — never a stored
+    `parsed` blob. mixed-hit/safe roles carry loaded=1/applicable=1,
+    forbid-false carries loaded=1/applicable=0, and mixed-off carries no
+    rule_summary key at all — the A12-R1 strict shape applies unchanged. The
+    recorded policy profile must be the family's own isolated profile (or
+    all-rules-disabled for off), and every finding on a hit role must belong
+    to the family's rule — the same SQL under five profiles can never borrow
+    a sibling role's record."""
+    if manifest.get("task_id") != "T06":
+        return []
+    frozen = {}
+    contract = t06_a1_contract()
+    for field, prefix in (("cli_cases", "T06.cli."), ("metadata_cases", "T06.meta.")):
+        for spec in contract[field]:
+            local = spec["id"]
+            if local.startswith("t06-a13-"):
+                frozen[prefix + local] = t06_a13_role_shape(local)
+    failures = []
+    for case in artifact.get("cases") or []:
+        case_id = case.get("case_id")
+        role = frozen.get(case_id)
+        if role is None:
+            continue
+        family, role_kind = role
+        try:
+            parsed = json.loads((case.get("actual") or {}).get("stdout") or "")
+        except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
+            continue  # the generic validator already reports unparseable stdout
+        if role_kind == "mixed-off":
+            if isinstance(parsed, dict) and "rule_summary" in parsed:
+                failures.append(
+                    f"T06-A13 {case_id}: rule_summary key must be absent "
+                    f"under the all-off control, found {parsed['rule_summary']!r}")
+            continue
+        if family not in T06_A13_RULES:
+            failures.append(f"T06-A13 {case_id}: unfrozen family {family!r}")
+            continue
+        want_loaded, want_applicable = (1, 1) if role_kind in ("mixed-hit", "safe") else (1, 0)
+        if not isinstance(parsed, dict) or "rule_summary" not in parsed:
+            failures.append(

+                    f"role {role_kind!r}")
+                continue

+                    "JSON integer (not bool/float/string/null)")

+                    f"{want_value} for role {role_kind!r}")

+                f"!= frozen {want_profile!r}")
+        if role_kind == "mixed-hit":

+                            f"{finding.get('rule_id')!r} borrowed — want {want_rule}")
+    return failures
